title: Geologic Map of the Steedman Quadrangle, Aiken and Lexington Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, and Howard, C.S., 2010, Geologic Map of the Steedman Quadrangle, Aiken and Lexington Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-49, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: OCR of a map sheet plus image reading of cross section A-A' (tiles p1-144dpi-crop30_2100_2430_2340-r1c1..c4). Hole elevations and interval tops/bottoms are read off the section's elevation scale (feet; about +/-3 ft) and flagged inferred. The section prints no horizontal scale, so no distances or contact points recorded. Hole 32-230 is drawn partly above the profile line (projected) and is left out. Map-face drill holes carry only log numbers; not recorded. Symbols for Pinehurst ('[ w |'), Altamaha and Tobacco Road are garbled in the text and left out. Contact and fault line symbols appear only in the explanation; faults recorded from the text.
